avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly reduces rilpivirine concentrations below therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated - do not use concurrently; consider alternative antidepressant if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin/Rifampicin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer markedly decreases rilpivirine plasma concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated - use alternative TB medication or separate antiretroviral regimen

avoid_supplements.name: Proton Pump Inhibitors (PPIs)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Elevated gastric pH reduces rilpivirine absorption; clinically significant bioavailability reduction
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use H2-receptor antagonist instead; if PPI necessary, separate dosing by 12+ hours

avoid_supplements.name: Antacids (Aluminum/Magnesium hydroxide)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Elevated gastric pH impairs rilpivirine dissolution and absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2-4 hours; preferably use alternative antacids or H2 blockers

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase rilpivirine concentrations modestly
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for adverse effects; consistent consumption advised over sporadic use

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce rilpivirine absorption if taken concurrently due to chelation
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2+ hours; take rilpivirine on empty stomach if possible

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Significantly increases rilpivirine absorption and plasma exposure; inconsistent dosing conditions
avoid_foods.action: Take rilpivirine with food but NOT high-fat meals; consistent moderate food intake recommended

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may moderately elevate rilpivirine concentrations
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; if used, maintain consistent intake rather than sporadic use

caution_foods.name: Cranberry products
caution_foods.mechanism: May modestly affect gastric pH and absorption
caution_foods.action: No strict avoidance needed; monitor efficacy if high intakes used

monitoring_notes: Rilpivirine requires consistent food intake (light to moderate meal) for optimal absorption and has narrow therapeutic window; monitor for virologic failure or adverse effects with significant diet changes or supplement use. Gastric pH alterations are critical concern due to rilpivirine's pH-dependent absorption profile.
